protocol.when: Load with every command. It governs preflight, checkpoints, resumption, and closing report.
protocol.preflight: Before every command, confirm single-repository or multi-repository scope from either explicit developer confirmation or current canonical evidence. Treat the current workspace as proposed, never proof. When repository evidence is absent, complete the repo-access protocol before reading, editing, or validating source; a new repository may explicitly confirm that no source exists yet. Do not inspect or change source until that sequence is complete. Then validate required input, target artifact, stage, and access before output.
protocol.checkpoint: Before material questions, edits, validation, retries, or handoff, save stage, run state, last action, resume reference, exactly one next action, and the update date in the command's state record; a foundation record also names the command it belongs to, and a work-item record also carries its scope revision. For foundation work the state record and the decision record are the same file, holding both a Run State row and a Decisions row.
protocol.context: For a work-item continuation, resolve current-work-item before validating stage. Dispatch only the saved next action; never skip a stage.
protocol.resume: Resume when prerequisites hold. The current-work-item protocol owns selecting, validating, recovering, and clearing that local context.
protocol.blocked: Record the material blocker and continuation condition; retry only when that condition changes or the developer directs it.
protocol.closure: Report artifact, outcome, blocker if any, and exactly one registered next action.
